prompt.label: Medium — Contract and Document Analysis
prompt.userMessage: Our procurement and legal teams review hundreds of vendor agreements every quarter, and identifying unusual clauses or inconsistent commercial terms has become increasingly difficult. Important obligations around renewals, pricing adjustments, or compliance requirements are often buried deep within lengthy documents. The current review process is heavily manual and depends on institutional knowledge from a small number of experienced employees. We are looking for a more scalable way to analyze large volumes of business documents and surface key risks or inconsistencies earlier in the process.

rounds.content:
{
  "action": "clarify",
  "round": 1,
  "message": "This could go a few different directions. Which is closest to what you want?

A) Contract review assistant — upload an agreement, AI extracts key clauses (renewals, pricing, compliance) and flags unusual terms vs. your standards
B) Contract Q&A chatbot — reviewers ask plain-English questions across the whole agreement library and get cited answers
C) Continuous risk monitor — AI scans all stored agreements on a schedule and surfaces anomalies/inconsistencies in a dashboard
D) Review workflow tracker — track who's reviewing which contract, with checklists per clause type and sign-off"
}

Email via MGA on processing_complete and high-severity flag creation. CSV export streams text/csv. Admin endpoints require role='admin'. Audit log written on every upload, extraction, and decision.",

    },

      "rules": [],

      "primarySnippet": "frontend/AppScaffold.tsx"
    },

      "scope": "integration",

  "data_model": {
    "tables": [
      {
        "name": "users",
        "columns": [

          {"name": "email", "type": "VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "role", "type": "VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reviewer'"},
          {"name": "created_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"}
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "standards",
        "columns": [
          {"name": "id", "type": "SERIAL PRIMARY KEY"},
          {"name": "category", "type": "VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "title", "type": "VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "body", "type": "TEXT NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "created_by", "type": "INTEGER REFERENCES users(id)"},
          {"name": "created_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"}
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "agreements",
        "columns": [
          {"name": "id", "type": "SERIAL PRIMARY KEY"},
          {"name": "user_id", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)"},
          {"name": "filename", "type": "VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "full_text", "type": "TEXT NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "status", "type": "VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'"},
          {"name": "uploaded_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"},
          {"name": "processed_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ"}
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "clauses",
        "columns": [
          {"name": "id", "type": "SERIAL PRIMARY KEY"},
          {"name": "agreement_id", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES agreements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE"},
          {"name": "category", "type": "VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "text", "type": "TEXT NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "source_start", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "source_end", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "created_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"}
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "flags",
        "columns": [
          {"name": "id", "type": "SERIAL PRIMARY KEY"},
          {"name": "clause_id", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clauses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE"},
          {"name": "agreement_id", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES agreements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE"},
          {"name": "severity", "type": "VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "reason", "type": "TEXT NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "matched_standard_id", "type": "INTEGER REFERENCES standards(id)"},
          {"name": "status", "type": "VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'"},
          {"name": "created_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"}
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "decisions",
        "columns": [
          {"name": "id", "type": "SERIAL PRIMARY KEY"},
          {"name": "flag_id", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES flags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE"},
          {"name": "user_id", "type": "INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)"},
          {"name": "action", "type": "VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "annotation", "type": "TEXT"},
          {"name": "created_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"}
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "audit_log",
        "columns": [
          {"name": "id", "type": "SERIAL PRIMARY KEY"},
          {"name": "user_id", "type": "INTEGER REFERENCES users(id)"},
          {"name": "event_type", "type": "VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "entity_type", "type": "VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL"},
          {"name": "entity_id", "type": "INTEGER"},
          {"name": "details", "type": "JSONB"},
          {"name": "created_at", "type": "TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()"}
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "api_contract": {
    "version": 1,
    "endpoints": [
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/whoami", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, email, role }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/agreements", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{ id, filename, status, uploaded_at, processed_at, flag_counts: {high,medium,low} }], total }"}},
      {"method": "POST", "path": "/agreements", "request": "multipart/form-data: file (PDF/doc) required", "response": {"status": 201, "body": "{ id, filename, status }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/agreements/:id", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ id, filename, full_text, status, uploaded_at, processed_at, clauses: [{ id, category, text, source_start, source_end, flags: [{ id, severity, reason, status, matched_standard_id }] }] }"}},
      {"method": "POST", "path": "/agreements/:id/extract", "response": {"status": 202, "body": "{ id, status }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/agreements/:id/export", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "text/csv stream of clauses+flags"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/flags", "request": "?agreement_id&severity&status&limit=50&offset=0", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{ id, agreement_id, clause_id, severity, reason, status, created_at }], total }"}},
      {"method": "POST", "path": "/flags/:id/decision", "request": "{ action: 'accept'|'dismiss'|'annotate' required, annotation: string optional }", "response": {"status": 201, "body": "{ id, flag_id, action, annotation, created_at }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/standards", "request": "?limit=50&offset=0", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{ id, category, title, body, created_at }], total }"}},
      {"method": "POST", "path": "/standards", "request": "{ category: string required, title: string required, body: string required }", "response": {"status": 201, "body": "{ id, category, title, body }"}},
      {"method": "DELETE", "path": "/standards/:id", "response": {"status": 204, "body": ""}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/admin/dashboard", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ flag_trends: [{ date, high, medium, low }], reviewer_activity: [{ user_id, email, decisions_count }], coverage: { total_agreements, processed, pending } }"}},
      {"method": "GET", "path": "/admin/audit-log", "request": "?limit=50&offset=0", "response": {"status": 200, "body": "{ items: [{ id, user_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id, details, created_at }], total }"}}
    ]
  },
  "ui_contract": {
    "primary_view": "list of uploaded agreements",
    "primary_action": "upload a vendor agreement for AI review",
    "secondary_views": [
      "agreement detail with extracted clauses and severity-ranked flags",
      "standards library management",
      "admin dashboard with flag trends and reviewer activity",
      "admin audit log"
    ],
    "components": [
      {"name": "AgreementUploader", "role": "drag-and-drop upload for vendor agreements"},
      {"name": "AgreementList", "role": "list of uploaded agreements with status and flag counts"},
      {"name": "AgreementDetail", "role": "source text view with inline clause highlights and citations"},
      {"name": "ClausePanel", "role": "extracted clauses grouped by category"},
      {"name": "FlagCard", "role": "single flag with severity badge, matched standard, and decision actions"},
      {"name": "SeverityBadge", "role": "color-coded high/medium/low indicator"},
      {"name": "DecisionActions", "role": "accept, dismiss, or annotate a flag"},
      {"name": "StandardsLibrary", "role": "admin view to add/remove organizational standard terms"},
      {"name": "AdminDashboard", "role": "charts for flag trends, reviewer activity, document coverage"},
      {"name": "AuditLogTable", "role": "paginated audit log of all system events"},
      {"name": "ExportButton", "role": "download clauses and flags as CSV"}
    ]
  },
  "business_logic_contract": {
    "triggers": [
      {"event": "user_first_login", "action": "create users row from OIDC claims (sub, email), default role='reviewer'"},
      {"event": "agreement_uploaded", "action": "parse PDF/doc text in-memory, persist full_text to agreements row, discard binary, enqueue extraction"},
      {"event": "extraction_run", "action": "call MGA to classify text into clause categories (renewals, pricing, compliance, other), persist clauses with source offsets, embed each clause, k-NN search standard_chunks, generate flag with severity for clauses deviating from standards"},
      {"event": "extraction_complete", "action": "set agreements.status='processed', processed_at=NOW(), send email notification to uploader via MGA"},
      {"event": "high_severity_flag_created", "action": "send email notification to uploader via MGA"},
      {"event": "standard_created", "action": "chunk body, embed via MGA, store in standard_chunks"},
      {"event": "decision_made", "action": "insert decisions row, update flags.status accordingly (accepted/dismissed/annotated)"}
    ],
    "rules": [
      "reviewers can only view and decide on flags for agreements they uploaded",
      "admins can view all agreements, flags, decisions, and the audit log",
      "/admin/* endpoints require role='admin' (403 otherwise)",
      "/standards POST and DELETE require role='admin'",
      "severity must be one of: 'high', 'medium', 'low'",
      "flag decision action must be one of: 'accept', 'dismiss', 'annotate'",
      "agreement file uploads are memory-only — binary discarded after text extraction"
    ],
    "side_effects": [
      "audit log entry on every agreement upload, extraction run, and reviewer decision",
      "email notification on processing complete and high-severity flag creation"
    ]
  },
  "vector_engine": "pgvector",
  "mga_assistants": [
    {
      "key": "default",
      "name": "Contract Clause Extractor",
      "description": "Analyzes vendor agreement text, extracts key clauses (renewals, pricing adjustments, compliance obligations), and flags unusual terms compared to organizational standards with severity ranking.",
      "model": "claude-opus-4.7",
      "tool_keys": [],
      "starter_messages": [
        "Extract all renewal and pricing clauses from this agreement.",
        "Flag any compliance obligations that deviate from our standards."
      ]
    }
  ]
}
